summary: Conversations run by the server, shown in the game's dialogue list with an optional line above it. A page is { line?, onRight?, options: [{ id, text, enabled? }] }, with 1 to 8 rows and unique ids. `enabled: false` only greys a row, so check costs in your handler. A player has one conversation at a time. Events are dialogueChoice(session, player, optionId) and dialogueClosed(session, player, reason), where the reason is 0 for Dialogue.close, 1 if the player backed out, 2 if another conversation replaced it, and 3 if interrupted because the player left, was knocked out or went out of reach, it timed out, or the NPC died. While a conversation is shown, the game starts none of its own for that player, so a nearby NPC's line does not end it.

open.summary: Opens a conversation and returns the session id. Returns 0 for an unusable page, or a player who is gone or still loading.

params.options: Optional: `npc`, an Npc or its id, is the speaker, and ends the session on dying or disappearing. `npc` or `position`, with `radius` (default 4 m), ends it when the player walks away. `timeout` in seconds, 0 for none, ends it if a page gets no choice for that long.

open.exampleLua:
local Dialogue = kcds.characters.Dialogue
local Events = kcds.core.Events

local firstPage = { line = "What brings you to the mill?", options = { { id = "work", text = "I am looking for work." }, { id = "bye", text = "Nothing. Farewell." } } }
Dialogue.open(player, firstPage, { npc = miller })

Events.on("dialogueChoice", function(session, speaker, optionId)
  if optionId == "bye" then
    Dialogue.close(session)
    return
  end
  Dialogue.update(session, { line = "Carry these sacks.", options = { { id = "bye", text = "Right away." } } })
end)

update.summary: Shows the next page. Returns false if the session has ended or the page is unusable.
update.exampleLua: kcds.characters.Dialogue.update(session, { line = "Prices went up again.", options = { { id = "bye", text = "Goodbye" } } })
update.exampleCs: Dialogue.Update(session, new { line = "Prices went up again.", options = new object[] { new { id = "bye", text = "Goodbye" } } });

close.summary: Ends the conversation with reason 0. Returns false if it has already ended.

activeSession.exampleLua:
if kcds.characters.Dialogue.activeSession(player) ~= 0 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Finish your conversation first.")
end
